findings.title: The analytic factor is dimensionally misstated and the retained-zero expectation needs a non-normative bit qualifier
findings.evidence: The full system has 21 residual rows and 19 retained columns, so B cannot literally be I19. The intended factor is the 21-by-19 embedded identity B[r,k]=1 exactly when r==retained_original_indices[k], with V=I19 and sigma=1. R06 also states every other retained coordinate is +0. That may be a valid independently derived bit result for this exact ordered diagonal fixture, but only held D +0 is canonical authority; the wording otherwise risks introducing zero-sign normalization in retained BVLS arithmetic.
findings.required_fix: State B's exact 21-by-19 row/slot formula. State expected retained-coordinate bit patterns as independently calculated results of the unchanged arithmetic, with no canonicalization, while retaining the normative +0 requirement only for D.

findings.title: L01 does not completely prescribe the direct selected-side seam
findings.evidence: At upper M=Cliq,H=0,D=0, dH=-1 selects Mixed phase. With all other upper M/H/D direction components zero, d_liquid=-1/LF and the capacity normal is negative, so the capacity branch is Drainage. The plan names only d_p,H=-1 and Mixed, leaving the other 20 direction components, lower-occupancy selection, and upper capacity branch unstated. An implementation could fill those operands from a predictor or candidate result despite the stated prohibition.
findings.required_fix: Freeze the complete 21-direction vector as +0 except the upper enthalpy component -1, explicitly expect upper Mixed/Drainage selection, freeze the lower selection from its stated base/direction operands, and require the direct selected assembly/validation seam to consume those values with the already declared 1 natural, 1 selected, 0 retry, and 1 new-base assembly counts.
